command_channel.title: Command channel
command_channel.description: The device was found, but it did not answer a status request on any known command channel, so the channel could not be detected. This can happen when the device is out of range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy that can deliver its replies. Pick the channel for your firmware if you know it, or leave it to be detected on the next connection.

error.invalid_device: This is not a supported Smart Matic device

update_status.name: Update status
update_status.description: Connects to the Godrej Aer Smart Matic device and refreshes its status. Bypasses the automatic retry cooldown. If no target is given, every configured device is updated.

init.title: Command channel
init.description: Current command channel: {current}. Choose "Detect automatically" to detect it again on the next connection, for example after a firmware update.
